world.title: Yemen's Houthis renew warning against using Riyadh airport
world.summary: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis issued a renewed warning against the use of Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport on Sunday. This statement came shortly after the airport announced the designation of two terminals for flights, following a suspension earlier in October. The Houthis' warning reflects ongoing tensions in the region and concerns over security related to the airport's operations.

world.title: Protests sweep France, Spain as masked mobs loot shops, clash with cops; 1,100 held
world.summary: Protests erupted in France and Spain on Saturday, marked by violence and clashes between demonstrators and police. In Barcelona, protesters set fire to streets and looted shops during anti-establishment rallies. Authorities reported over 1,100 arrests amid the unrest. The demonstrations reflect growing discontent with the establishment, leading to significant public disturbances in both countries.

world.title: ‘No line he will not cross’: Obama slams Ramaswamy’s ‘cruel’ ad, hits out at Trump
world.summary: Former US President Barack Obama has condemned Republican gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy for a "cruel" advertisement, stating that there is "no line he will not cross." Obama also criticized President Donald Trump and his Republican allies, alleging they have forsaken fundamental standards of decency in their political conduct, reflecting broader concerns about the current state of political discourse.

business.title: Upcoming IPO: MK Sons Fine Jewels’ ₹275 cr opening next week - Company profile, key dates, share price band and more
business.summary: MK Sons Fine Jewels is set to launch its IPO, aiming to raise ₹275 crore. The bidding for anchor investors will occur on October 27, one day prior to the opening for retail and other investors. Key dates and share price bands will be announced as the company prepares for its market debut next week.

business.title: MCA extends annual filing deadlines, waives extra fees for FY26 filings
business.summary: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) has extended the filing deadlines for FY26, allowing financial statements to be submitted by December 31 and annual returns by January 31. This decision includes waiving additional fees due to ongoing concerns regarding technical glitches in the filing portal. The extension aims to ease compliance burdens for businesses during this period.

business.title: IRDAI extends window for feedback on proposed insurance distribution reforms - check new deadline
business.summary: India's insurance regulator, IRDAI, has extended the deadline for public feedback on proposed insurance distribution reforms to October 31, 2026, from the previous date of October 25. This extension allows stakeholders more time to submit their opinions and suggestions regarding the reforms aimed at improving insurance distribution practices in the country. Further details can be found in the announcement.

technology.title: iPhone 17 Pro Max gets up to Rs 56,250 discount with bank offer and exchange
technology.summary: The iPhone 17 Pro Max (256GB) is priced at Rs 1,49,900 on Flipkart. However, an exchange offer combined with a discount for HDFC Bank customers can reduce the effective price to Rs 93,650, depending on eligibility. This promotion provides a potential savings of up to Rs 56,250 for eligible buyers looking to purchase the device.

technology.title: iPhone 17 Pro Max gets up to Rs 56,250 discount with bank offer and exchange
technology.summary: The iPhone 17 Pro Max (256GB) is priced at Rs 1,49,900 on Flipkart. Buyers can receive discounts through exchange offers and HDFC Bank promotions, reducing the effective price to Rs 93,650, depending on eligibility. This offer allows customers to save up to Rs 56,250 on the purchase of the smartphone, enhancing affordability for potential buyers.

technology.title: Apple's iPhone Duo Fails JerryRigEverything's Durability Test
technology.summary: Apple's iPhone Duo underwent a durability test by JerryRigEverything, revealing several issues. The inner display was found to be easily scratchable, and debris was noted around the hinge. Additionally, the repair cost for the device, priced at $1,999, was reported to be $1,000. These findings may influence potential buyers considering the foldable phone.

sports.title: Drawn in same group, India-Pakistan set to clash on November 22 in Rising Asia Cup
sports.summary: The Asian Cricket Council (ACC) has released the schedule for the 2026 Rising Asia Cup in Doha. India A and Pakistan A have been placed in the same group, setting the stage for a match on November 22. Fans of both teams are expected to show strong support, reminiscent of previous high-stakes encounters between the two cricketing rivals.

sports.title: Jorge Martin planning MotoGP return at Malaysian GP
sports.summary: Jorge Martin, a contender for the 2026 MotoGP title, is aiming to return at the Malaysian Grand Prix after being sidelined from the Australian race due to an injury. He crashed on lap eight during the Phillip Island sprint, which resulted in his withdrawal from the event. Martin is optimistic about his recovery and participation in the upcoming race.

sports.title: WTA Ningbo Final Prediction
sports.summary: Elena Rybakina and Leylah Fernandez will compete in the WTA Ningbo final in China. Rybakina, the top seed, is aiming for consecutive titles after defeating sixth seed Diana Shnaider 6-3, 7-5 in the semifinals. Both players are poised to showcase their skills as they vie for the championship on Sunday, with Rybakina appearing to be in peak form.

health.title: An AI that reads your face can now estimate how long you have to live
health.summary: Researchers at Mass General Brigham developed FAHR-Face, an AI that analyzes facial photos to estimate biological age and predict survival in cancer patients. Trained on over 40 million images, the AI identified high-risk patients, with half of those flagged dying within 90 days. The technology is still experimental and raises ethical concerns regarding its application.

health.title: Most people may have a high genetic risk for diseases such as diabetes, heart disease and schizophrenia, study finds
health.summary: A study suggests that many individuals may possess a high genetic risk for common diseases such as diabetes, heart disease, and schizophrenia, potentially ranking in the top 10% for these risks. Despite this genetic predisposition, many people feel healthy and exhibit no symptoms, indicating that genetic risk does not always correlate with actual disease development.

health.title: Ebola cases in DR Congo rise to 9,816, death toll reaches 4,757
health.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported a rise in confirmed Ebola cases to 9,816, with the death toll reaching 4,757, as stated by the Ministry of Communications and Media. Response measures are ongoing across eight provinces to address the outbreak. The situation remains critical as health authorities work to contain the virus and prevent further spread.

science.title: Democratizing reliable knowledge-seeking with MyGPT: a privacy-first, open-source retrieval-augmented generation platform
science.summary: MyGPT is a privacy-first, open-source retrieval-augmented generation platform designed to enhance knowledge discovery while addressing privacy concerns. It allows users to query user-defined libraries, such as biomedical literature and clinical documents, without data leakage. MyGPT includes confidence metrics and source citations to evaluate answer reliability, providing a secure, cost-effective alternative to commercial large language model services.

science.title: Scientists propose a way to detect dangerous “mirror life” before it exists
science.summary: Scientists from the University of Strathclyde and Durham University have proposed a method to detect "mirror life," a hypothetical life form that could threaten ecosystems and humans. The technique involves special fluorescent molecules that emit light with distinct left and right-handed properties. By analyzing these light signals, researchers aim to differentiate ordinary organisms from their mirror-image counterparts.

science.title: IIT-M Faculty Makes Key Inputs to Global Study on Molecular Electronics
science.summary: Dr. Anil Kumar Singh, an assistant professor at IIT-Madras, contributed significantly to a global study on molecular electronics. The international team, comprising researchers from India, Israel, Germany, Denmark, and China, demonstrated that electric current can induce the rotation of a single molecule, enhancing electrical conduction by up to 100 times. The findings have been published in a scientific journal.

Staying receptive can lead to personal growth and fulfillment.

entertainment.summary: On October 25, 2026, Capricorns are advised to refrain from forcing their future. Instead, they should take a step back and reassess their situation. Gaining a new perspective will help them identify necessary changes. After this reflection, they can return to planning and pursuing their goals with a clearer understanding of what needs to be adjusted.

entertainment.summary: Taurus individuals are faced with several choices today, ranging from appealing but risky options to safer, less exciting ones.
